intent.raw: Run subagents in fan out and use invoke refresh to refresh the glossary.
intent.objective: Refresh domainspec-lean-formalization/GLOSSARY.md from the latest research brief, claim ledger, relation ledger, validation ledger, and fan-out receipts while preserving claim-proof discipline.
intent.operator_sentence: Use delegated fan-out to identify glossary deltas, synthesize them through invoke refresh, apply only the approved scoped glossary update, and record refresh evidence.

route_menu.context_hint: The user approved a scoped glossary refresh after the research strategy execution.

items.label: Apply scoped glossary refresh
items.description: Patch only the target glossary and write invoke refresh receipts.

items.label: Proposal only
items.description: Write refresh reports without mutating the glossary.

technique_overlays.trigger: Refresh mode requires source signals, target inventory, declared scope, mutation mode, and evidence-mapped deltas.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Every glossary change maps to a RefreshSignal and evidence path.

technique_overlays.trigger: The glossary contains theorem, conjecture, analogy, and build-status terms.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Glossary wording separates source-level proof, build evidence, sorry-free, axiom-free, PR-ready, conjecture, analogy, and demoted relation language.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The user explicitly requested subagents in fan out for the glossary refresh.
subagent_strategy.explanation: The glossary touches math terms, proof-status wording, and cross-repository relation language; separate lanes reduce overclaiming and coverage gaps.
context: domainspec-lean-formalization/GLOSSARY.md is current but predates the 2026-06-01 research synthesis.
ops/development/domainspec-lean-formalization-research-brief.md identifies typed residue accounting as the bounded reading.
ops/development/domainspec-lean-formalization-claim-discipline-ledger.md separates theorem, build, sorry, axiom, PR-ready, conjecture, analogy, and demoted claims.
ops/development/domainspec-lean-formalization-relation-ledger.md demotes literal isomorphism language and prefers register/bridge wording.

roles.purpose: Find glossary terms to add, update, or leave unchanged based on the latest research synthesis.
Audit glossary wording for overclaims around proof, build, sorry-free, axiom-free, PR-ready, conjecture, analogy, and demoted claims.
Identify safe relation vocabulary for Arcanum, CyberAlchemy, implementation/domainspec, and research/projects/domainspec boundaries.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Already approved by user request: run sub agents in fan out and invoke refresh the glossary.
receipt_requirements: Return proposed glossary term deltas with evidence paths and line numbers.
Classify each recommendation as add, update, no-op, demote, or defer.
Do not edit files in subagent lanes.
Flag any glossary change that would require theorem source, ontology, inventory, or sibling-repo mutation.

steps.name: Collect source evidence and target inventory
stop_conditions: Block if target glossary is missing.
Block if source evidence is missing.

steps.name: Run glossary refresh fan-out lanes
convergence_criteria: Every material recommendation cites source evidence.
stop_conditions: Flag timed-out lanes and continue only with parent evidence if enough source evidence remains.

steps.name: Synthesize invoke refresh deltas
stop_conditions: Every proposed or applied change must map to a RefreshSignal.

steps.name: Apply scoped glossary refresh
stop_conditions: Only edit the target glossary and refresh receipts.
Do not edit Lean theorem/proof source.

steps.name: Validate dispatch, refresh receipts, and scoped file changes
stop_conditions: Flag if changed glossary wording contains unsupported theorem, build, or relation claims.

gates.condition: Target artifact inventory names domainspec-lean-formalization/GLOSSARY.md and refresh receipt paths.
User request approves scoped glossary refresh; no other canonical artifact may be mutated.
Glossary changes separate theorem source, build evidence, sorry-free, axiom-free, PR-ready, conjecture, analogy, refuted, and demoted relation claims.
The run refreshes the existing target glossary only and does not promote candidate terms into Inventory, Ontology, sigil, spell, or sibling-repo authority.

boundaries.contract: Apply only scoped glossary wording updates backed by source evidence.
Lean source may be cited but not edited.

authority.execution: parent synthesis plus approved scoped patch
authority.evidence: path-cited refresh signals and fan-out receipts
authority.memory: memory visibility only; no memory update requested

promotion_splits.target: inventory, ontology, sigil, spell, and sibling-repo authority
promotion_splits.rule: Evidence may inform future routes but is not promoted here.

promotion_guardrails: The route refreshes only the existing target glossary and writes refresh receipts.
The route does not mutate Lean theorem/proof source.
The route does not promote candidate relation terms into ontology or inventory authority.
The route preserves theorem, build, sorry, axiom, PR-ready, conjecture, analogy, refuted, and demoted claim distinctions.
